step_by_step_reasoning: The architecture shows a serverless data analytics portal and environment for data scientists at Sanofi. Users connect via CloudFront to a static website hosted on Amazon S3. Authentication flows through Amazon Cognito integrated with Sanofi SSO. Dynamic tracking and metadata logging go through API Gateway to DynamoDB. Service Catalog provisions data science tools like RStudio (running on EC2) and Amazon SageMaker. AWS Lambda handles batch processing and text analytics by interfacing with Amazon Translate and Amazon Comprehend Medical. A central S3 Data Lake stores the sensitive underlying datasets.
